method.sources: pinned OpenWrt buildroot, feeds and component checkouts

patch_introduced_registrations.note: A patch that registers an object is reported with every .name literal it adds; those literals may be object names, object-type names or blobmsg policy fields, so each site needs reading before its objects are claimed.

ubus_dynamic_objects.name_rule: container (registered only when procd runs the ujail container path)
dnsmasq instance name from --ubus option, default DNSMASQ_UBUS_NAME

ubus_method_confirmation_note: methods_confirmed_in_artifact lists method-name literals found in the deployed artifact's bytes.  It is positive evidence only: linker string merging makes absence undecidable, so a method missing from this list is not evidence that the build lacks it.  Build-time method gating must be read from the recipe (see sources.json build option evidence).
ubus_role_note: dynamic_symbol_names records which libubus entry-point names appear in the stripped artifact's dynamic string data.  It shows the linked interface, not that the code path runs on this device.
